Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12071 of 2024
Applicant :- Sartaj Ali

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Javed Habib
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ikram Ahmad
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Sri Javed Habeeb learned counsel for the applicant; Sri Ikram Ahmad, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Santosh Nigam, learned AGA for the State-respondent.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
411 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 313, 325 IPC and 3/4 DP Act and Section 3/4 Muslim Women(Protection of right on Marriage) Act, Police Station Kotwali, District Budaun,
during pendency of the trial in the court below.

entities.text: Muslim Women(Protection of right on Marriage) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. FIR of the present case was lodged on 9.10.2023 against the applicant and his family members and according to the FIR, marriage of the applicant was performed with the informant and after marriage applicant and family members tortured her for Fortuner car and Rs. Twenty lacs and applicant about 15 days before beaten her and also tried to commit her murder.
4. It is further mentioned in the FIR that when earlier informant became pregnant then applicant caused her miscarriage.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is husband of the informant and actually some matrimonial dispute arose between husband and wife and only due to this reason, FIR of the present case was lodged.

6. He further submitted that however in the FIR, there is also allegation of miscarriage against the applicant but this allegation was staled one and from the record it reflects that in the year 2022,
miscarriage of the informant was caused.
7.

He further submitted that however, from the injury report of the injured, it reflects that she sustained fracture on her ring finger but it appears that merely by falling or in some other manner,
she sustained injury and due to the matrimonial discord she lodged FIR of the present case against the applicant and his family members.
8. He further submitted that applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 20.2.2024.

9. Per contra, learned AGA as well as counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant who is husband of the informant continuously tortured her alongwith his family members since after her marriage and although, it is the duty of the husband to maintain his wife but instead of doing so, applicant not only made assault upon her but also caused her miscarriage but both the counsel could not dispute the fact that the injury report suggests that the present case does not travel beyond section 325 IPC.
10.
They further could not dispute the fact that the allegation of miscarriage is of the year 2022 and applicant is in jail since February, 2024.
11. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

12. However, applicant is husband of the informant and as per allegation, he alongwith his family members tortured her and also made assault and caused her miscarriage but allegation with regard to the miscarriage appears to be old one as record suggests that the incident of miscarriage occurred in the year 2022.

13. Further, however, from the x-ray report of the informant, it reflects that she sustained fracture on her ring finger but considering the injuries, argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant that the injury can be caused even by mere falling, cannot be ruled out, at this stage.
14. Further, even if there is fracture in ring finger then also case does not travel beyond section 325 IPC which is bailable.
15. Further, applicant is in jail in the present matter since February, 2024.

16. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

sentences.text: Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

18. Let the applicant-Sunny Sharma, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
19. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

20. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
